battle.name: 埃以消耗戰爭
battle.brief: 埃以消耗戰爭於一九六八年三月爆發，埃及與以色列在蘇伊士運河及西奈前線互相攻擊，使邊界交火長期化。相關軍備中的法國雷管步槍（Percussion rifle）於一八四〇年服役，屬線列步兵用於中距離精確射擊的制式單兵火器。其瞄射與裝填動作均納入步兵日常訓練。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管步槍是法國陸軍線列步兵的制式單兵火器，配發於營內步兵分隊，負責中距離瞄射；其操作訓練與射擊紀律由連、營指揮體系掌握。

countries: 參戰國與戰區：1968年消耗戰的主戰場是埃及與以色列之間，戰線承接1967年6月戰後尚未解決的停火線，核心階段則由1968年3月延續至8月。埃及在蘇伊士運河兩側部署武裝部隊第二、第三軍區所屬步兵、裝甲、炮兵及突擊部隊，控制北面的阿里什、努格迪比亞與阿布烏格伊拉，中段的戴維索瓦、卡布里特，以及南面的伊斯梅利亞、蘇伊士和大苦湖；以色列由南方司令部統轄西奈步兵師、裝甲旅、傘兵和工兵部隊，重點防守阿里什至蘇伊士的公路、運河東岸與大苦湖周邊。敘利亞不是與埃及互換戰場的對手，但其在戈蘭山地的米特拉山口、班尼亞斯與黑門山一線同步施壓，迫使以軍不能把全部預備隊投入西奈。埃及與以色列是直接交戰方；蘇聯向埃及提供飛機、坦克、炮兵和防空武器，美國向以色列提供航空裝備與電子設備，兩者均不是直接部署於戰場的一方。
countriesEn: Belligerents and theaters: The principal theater of the War of Attrition in 1968 lay between Egypt and Israel. Its front inherited the unresolved ceasefire line that followed the June 1967 war, while its central phase ran from March to August 1968. Egypt deployed infantry, armored, artillery, and commando units from the Second and Third Military Regions on both sides of the Suez Canal, holding Al-Arish, Nagidbia, and Abu Augeila in the north; Deversoir and Kabrit in the center; and Ismailia, Suez, and the Great Bitter Lake in the south. The Israeli Southern Command controlled infantry divisions, armored brigades, paratroopers, and engineers in Sinai, concentrating on the Al-Arish–Suez road, the east bank of the canal, and the approaches to the Great Bitter Lake. Syria was not an interchangeable opponent on Egypt's principal front, but it applied simultaneous pressure at Mitla Pass, Banias, and Mount Hermon on the Golan, preventing Israel from committing every reserve unit to Sinai. Egypt and Israel were the direct belligerents. The Soviet Union supplied Egypt with aircraft, tanks, artillery, and air-defense weapons, while the United States supplied Israel with aviation equipment and electronics; neither supporting state was itself deployed as a belligerent.
people: 主要人物與指揮鏈：埃及總統加梅爾·阿卜杜勒·納賽爾掌握最高政治與軍事決策，國防部長兼武裝部隊最高指揮官阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾在1968年上半年主持戰區指揮，參謀長阿明·豪伊迪則負責日常軍令系統；哈立德·穆希丁少將指揮埃及第四裝甲師，並在3月22日以軍「贈禮行動」的空襲與火力打擊中陣亡。以色列方面，總參謀長海姆·巴列夫於1968年1月接任，南方司令部由耶沙亞胡·加維什主持，空軍司令莫德凱·霍德負責制空、對地攻擊與航空情報支援；傘兵、裝甲和工兵指揮官則把這三項命令轉譯成渡河破壞、火力反擊與縱深機動。敘利亞參謀長穆斯塔法·塔拉斯是戈蘭戰線的主要決策者。戰役中的實際效果不只取決於上述高級指揮官：埃及砲兵測量官能否迅速修正諸元、突擊隊能否把渡河器材送上岸，以及以色列飛行員能否在有限空域內找到射擊窗口，才決定了各次交鋒的勝負。
peopleEn: Principal figures and the chain of command: Egyptian President Gamal Abdel Nasser controlled the highest political and military decisions. Defense Minister and commander-in-chief Abdel Hakim Amer directed operations during the first half of 1968, while Chief of Staff Amin Howeidi ran the regular military order system. Major General Khaled Mohieddin commanded the Egyptian Fourth Armored Division and was killed during the aerial and artillery attack of Operation Gift on March 22. On the Israeli side, Chief of Staff Haim Bar-Lev took office in January 1968; Yeshayahu Gavish headed Southern Command; and Air Force commander Mordechai Hod was responsible for air superiority, ground attack, and aerial intelligence. Paratroop, armored, and engineer commanders translated those three levels of command into cross-canal raids, counterbattery missions, and mobile operations deep into enemy territory. Mustafa Tlass, the Syrian chief of staff, was the principal decision-maker on the Golan front. The practical results of the campaign depended on more than senior commanders: Egyptian artillery observers had to correct firing data quickly, commando units had to place assault equipment ashore, and Israeli pilots had to find firing opportunities within a constrained airspace. Those tasks determined the outcome of individual engagements.
kits: 裝備與後勤：以色列在1968年可使用的航空主力包括達索特Mirage IIIC與IIE、麥道F-4A/B/C、費爾斯A-4 Skyhawk及IAI Mystère IV；地面主力有M48A3與M60A1戰車、105毫米野戰砲、M105 155毫米拖曳榴彈砲、M110 203毫米自走砲及Soltam M24 155毫米自走砲，並以Uzi、FAL與MAG 58步槍、機槍構成步兵火力，鷹式防空系統則用於保護前沿陣地。埃及空軍擁有MiG-21PF與MiG-21FL、MiG-17F/PF，地面部隊裝備T-55與T-62戰車、122毫米D-30、130毫米M46、152毫米及203毫米榴彈砲，SA-2防空導彈則用於掩護運河沿岸與機場。埃及把後方鐵路、公路轉運線接到塞德港、伊斯梅利亞和蘇伊士，在卡布里特、戴維索瓦一帶設置前進彈藥與補給點；以色列則由加利特、比爾吉夫加法以及雷菲迪姆、奧夫達等後方基地，經西奈公路把炮彈、燃料與配件送至砲兵群。實戰射擊並非盡量連發：各砲種以短時間集中火力後轉移陣位，觀察所回報落點，後方再依射擊計畫分批送彈，因此補給線安全與砲位輪換速度直接影響每日射擊量。
kitsEn: Equipment and logistics: Israel's available combat aircraft in 1968 included the Dassault Mirage IIIC and IIIE, McDonnell F-4A/B/C, Fairchild A-4 Skyhawk, and IAI Mystère IV. Its principal ground equipment comprised M48A3 and M60A1 tanks, 105 mm field howitzers, M105 155 mm towed howitzers, M110 203 mm self-propelled howitzers, and Soltam M24 155 mm self-propelled howitzers. Uzi, FAL, and MAG 58 rifles and machine guns supplied infantry firepower, while HAWK surface-to-air batteries protected forward positions. The Egyptian Air Force operated MiG-21PF and MiG-21FL as well as MiG-17F/PF aircraft. Egyptian ground forces used T-55 and T-62 tanks, 122 mm D-30 and 130 mm M46 guns, and 152 mm and 203 mm howitzers, with SA-2 surface-to-air missiles shielding canal towns and airfields. Egypt connected rail and road transport from the rear to Port Said, Ismailia, and Suez, then established forward ammunition and supply points around Kabrit and Deversoir. Israel moved shells, fuel, and spare parts from rear bases at Galat, Bir Gifgafa, Refidim, and Ovda along the Sinai roads. Field firing was not simply a matter of firing as rapidly as possible. Batteries concentrated fire briefly, displaced, received corrected target data from observation posts, and then received ammunition in planned deliveries. The security of supply routes and the speed of gun displacement therefore directly governed daily rates of fire.
tactics: 作戰經過：3月初，埃及把突擊營、第四裝甲師及配套部隊集中到蘇伊士、伊斯梅利亞、卡布里特和運河中段的渡河點，準備以橡皮艇及小型船艇分批過河，並在對岸建立可容納火炮、指揮所和後續部隊的據點。以軍情報確認集結後，於3月22日下午至夜間發動「贈禮行動」，以空襲、砲火和裝甲封鎖同時打擊正在渡河、尚未渡河及正在加固的埃及部隊，切斷其由運河西岸向東岸推進的連續性。此次行動範圍有限，以軍沒有為全面地面戰爭而全面動員。埃及隨後仍維持沿運河部署。6月19日，埃及在巴列夫線發動大規模砲火攻擊，敘利亞同時在戈蘭高地施壓；埃及以130毫米至203毫米砲火壓制前沿陣位、通信所和觀察所，再以步兵、機槍及突擊分隊在砲火掩護下渡河。以色列的反制不是正面強渡運河，而是以炮兵反擊、 Mirage與A-4對地攻擊、裝甲縱深掃蕩及突擊隊夜間渡河破壞並行。傘兵與工兵乘小艇進入運河東岸，攻擊砲位、雷達站、通信節點與彈藥點，完成破壞後即撤回。7月，以色列加強對中央西奈與蘇伊士公路的縱深行動，迫使埃及砲兵分散、轉移並延長補給；埃及MiG-21則嘗試以雙機協同攔截，但以軍仍掌握大部分空中主動權。SA-2防空陣地迫使進攻機調整高度和航線，卻未能扭轉整體空優。8月9日埃及接受停火，這一階段的正面砲戰才逐漸停止。
tacticsEn: Course of operations: In early March, Egypt concentrated commando troops, the Fourth Armored Division, and supporting units at crossing points near Suez, Ismailia, Kabrit, and the middle reaches of the canal. The plan was to cross in waves in rubber boats and small craft and establish positions on the opposite bank capable of receiving artillery, command posts, and follow-on troops. After intelligence confirmed the concentration, Israel launched Operation Gift from the afternoon into the night of March 22. Air strikes, artillery fire, and armored interdiction struck Egyptian troops that were crossing, preparing to cross, or consolidating positions, breaking the continuity of the movement from the canal's west bank to the east. The operation remained limited, and Israel did not mobilize for a general ground war. Egypt nevertheless maintained its canal deployment. On June 19, Egypt launched a major bombardment against the Bar Lev Line while Syria applied simultaneous pressure on the Golan. Egyptian 130 mm to 203 mm guns suppressed forward positions, communications posts, and observation stations, after which infantry, machine-gun teams, and commando detachments crossed under cover. Israel's response did not consist of a frontal canal assault. It combined counterbattery fire, Mirage and A-4 ground attacks, deep armored sweeps, and night commando crossings. Paratroopers and engineers entered the east bank in small boats to attack gun positions, radar stations, communications nodes, and ammunition points before withdrawing. In July, Israel intensified operations in central Sinai and along the Suez road, forcing Egyptian artillery to disperse, displace, and operate with longer supply routes. Egyptian MiG-21s attempted two-aircraft interception missions, but Israel retained most of the initiative in the air. SA-2 positions forced attacking aircraft to alter altitude and approach routes but did not reverse the wider Israeli air advantage. Egypt accepted a ceasefire on August 9, after which the direct artillery combat of this phase gradually stopped.
data: 時間與火力數據：可核對的主要節點包括1968年3月22日約16時開始的「贈禮行動」、6月19日埃及與敘利亞同步發動的炮火攻勢、7月縱深機動與渡河破壞達到高峰，以及8月9日18時生效的埃及停火。從3月22日至8月9日約四個半月，埃及在運河正面集結的火力被後續軍事史著作概估為超過一千門砲，後文常引用的高峰射擊量約為每日二十五萬發；這類數字主要來自回憶錄與二手概述，並非逐日核對的射擊紀錄，應視為量級上限而非精確日耗。以色列同時以數百門105、155與203毫米砲反擊，但公開資料沒有完整、可核的每日發射表。3月22日埃及突擊部隊的死亡數，各方公開說法從大量損失到逾百人不等，現有資料不足以支持單一精確數字；1968年階段埃及、以色列與敘利亞的總傷亡也因分類、統計期間和戰俘交換不同而無法可靠核對，因此不能把二手估算寫成定論。較能確認的是，以軍在首日重創了埃及已集結而尚未完成渡河的突擊兵力，而埃及仍維持運河沿線的炮兵與裝甲存在。
dataEn: Dates and firepower: The principal verifiable milestones are the start of Operation Gift at approximately 16:00 on March 22, 1968; the coordinated Egyptian and Syrian bombardments of June 19; the peak of deep mobile operations and cross-canal raids in July; and the Egyptian ceasefire that took effect at 18:00 on August 9. Across roughly four and a half months from March 22 to August 9, later military histories estimate that Egypt concentrated more than one thousand guns along the canal. The frequently quoted peak expenditure of approximately 250,000 shells per day derives mainly from memoirs and secondary summaries rather than a day-by-day firing record, so it should be treated as an upper estimate of scale rather than an exact daily total. Israel returned fire with hundreds of 105 mm, 155 mm, and 203 mm guns, but no complete and verifiable public daily expenditure table exists. Published accounts of Egyptian commando deaths on March 22 range from substantial losses to more than one hundred, and the surviving evidence does not support a single exact figure. Total Egyptian, Israeli, and Syrian losses during the 1968 phase likewise cannot be reliably reconciled because sources classify casualties, periods, and prisoners differently. The more defensible conclusions are that Israel severely damaged the Egyptian assault troops before they completed their crossings on the first day, while Egypt retained an artillery and armored presence along the canal.
cause: 戰爭原因：1968年消耗戰不是單一事件引發，而是戰後控制問題、兩套作戰理論與外交僵局逐步重疊的結果。埃及在1967年失去西奈與戈蘭的大片控制區後，把重兵重新部署到蘇伊士運河附近，希望以集中炮兵、反覆突擊和長期消耗削弱以色列的先發優勢，並迫使以色列放棄過於外露的堡壘。以軍情報若確認埃及突擊營已在多個渡河點集結，就必須在對方完成渡河與砲兵展開前摧毀其力量，否則運河東岸的縱深會落入埃及控制。敘利亞則把以色列主力被釘在西奈視為在戈蘭重新部署的機會，遂與埃及在時間上配合，但兩軍的戰區、指揮鏈與目標仍各自獨立。蘇聯對埃及的軍事援助和美國對以色列的支援，使兩邊都有能力維持長期炮火消耗，卻不願立即接受會被另一方視為失敗的全面談判。3月22日的以色列先制打擊改變了交戰節奏，6月19日埃及與敘利亞的大炮火則把有限報復提升為公開、持續的消耗戰。
causeEn: Causes: The War of Attrition in 1968 was not produced by a single incident. It emerged as unresolved questions of postwar control, competing operational doctrines, and diplomatic deadlock overlapped. After losing control of much of Sinai and the Golan in 1967, Egypt redeployed large forces near the Suez Canal, seeking to use massed artillery, repeated commando attacks, and prolonged attrition to weaken Israel's earlier advantage and force the abandonment of exposed fortifications. If Israeli intelligence confirmed that Egyptian commandos were massing at several crossing points, Israel had to destroy that force before it completed the crossing and deployed artillery; otherwise the eastern bank and its depth would come under Egyptian control. Syria treated Israel as pinned down in Sinai as an opportunity to redeploy in the Golan and therefore synchronized its pressure with Egypt, although the two armies retained separate theaters, command chains, and objectives. Soviet military aid to Egypt and American support to Israel gave both sides the means to sustain prolonged artillery warfare, but neither wanted immediate negotiations that the other side could portray as a defeat. Israel's preemptive attack of March 22 changed the rhythm of the confrontation, and the Egyptian and Syrian bombardments of June 19 elevated a limited reprisal into an open war of attrition.
impact: 作戰影響：「贈禮行動」使埃及原定的多點渡河計畫失去連續性，為以色列爭取約三個月的重整時間，也迫使埃及把突擊部隊分散到更南的渡河點並提高警戒。以軍在空域與裝甲方面的優勢能夠攻擊埃及後方目標，卻受到SA-2防空陣地、運河兩岸的觀察網及反砲火限制；空軍優勢因此不等於能讓任何地面部隊長久留在運河東岸。6月19日以後的連續砲擊迫使以色列放棄或後撤部分最外線哨位，把前沿改成較縱深、能互相支援的據點，砲兵也須頻繁轉移陣地。以色列的縱深裝甲掃蕩和夜間渡河破壞則使埃及砲兵與彈藥前送更加困難，部分運河東岸據點被迫反覆應付由西岸發動的局部突擊。埃及雖損失突擊兵力，仍保住運河兩岸主要軍事部署與整條航路；以色列則沒有取得足以迫使其全面撤退的戰役成果。停火線因此不是單方面復原1967年界線，而是在雙方各自能持續防守或補給的區域形成，後續分階段撤軍與有限協議都以這條線為基礎。
impactEn: Operational effects: Operation Gift broke the continuity of Egypt's planned multi-point crossings and bought Israel roughly three months to reorganize. Egypt dispersed its commando units toward more southerly crossing points and increased security. Israeli superiority in aircraft and armor allowed attacks on Egyptian rear positions, but SA-2 batteries, an observation network on both banks of the canal, and Egyptian counterbattery fire constrained that advantage. Air superiority did not permit any ground formation to remain permanently on the east bank. The sustained bombardment after June 19 forced Israel to abandon or pull back some of its most exposed outposts, reorganize the front into deeper mutually supporting positions, and displace its guns more frequently. In turn, Israeli armored sweeps and night cross-canal raids complicated Egyptian artillery movement and ammunition supply and compelled several east-bank positions to respond repeatedly to attacks launched from the west bank. Egypt lost assault troops but retained the principal military deployments around the canal and control of the waterway. Israel did not obtain a battlefield result large enough to compel a general Egyptian withdrawal. The ceasefire line therefore did not simply restore the June 1967 boundary; it formed through areas each side could still defend or supply, and the later phased disengagement and limited agreements were based on that line.
result: 戰役結果：1968年8月9日18時，埃及接受停火，敘利亞與以色列亦分別接受戈蘭停火安排；雙方沒有因此達成永久和平。停火後，埃及重新控制北西奈主要地區、阿布烏格伊拉以及蘇伊士運河西岸的塞德港、伊斯梅利亞與蘇伊士，以色列則保留沙姆沙伊赫及通往阿克拉巴灣的南部沿海地帶，並繼續控制戈蘭高地的大部分區域。從作戰成果看，3月22日是明確的以色列 tactical 成功，因為他破壞了埃及突擊過河的組織與連續性；6月以後則是埃及有限但實際的戰略逆轉，埃及以受控的突擊與集中炮火迫使以色列調整防線，並避免在1968年內被完全逐出運河一帶。埃及為此支付了龐大的裝備消耗與部隊損失，以色列則未能把空優和裝甲優勢轉化為摧毀埃及軍隊的地面成果，雙方都沒有達成決定性勝利。整場消耗戰並未在1968年結束，零星炮火與有限攻勢延續到1970年8月7日，最後一階段停火生效後才正式結束；但本文記錄的1968年階段，已以8月9日停火和新的前線部署作為終點。
resultEn: Result: At 18:00 on August 9, 1968, Egypt accepted a ceasefire, while Syria and Israel separately accepted arrangements governing the Golan front. Neither side thereby achieved a permanent peace. After the ceasefire, Egypt regained control of most of northern Sinai, Abu Augeila, and the principal military positions on the canal's west bank, including Port Said, Ismailia, and Suez. Israel retained Sharm el-Sheikh and a southern coastal corridor leading toward the Gulf of Aqaba, and it continued to control most of the Golan Heights. In operational terms, March 22 was a clear Israeli tactical success because it disrupted Egyptian crossing organization and continuity. After June, Egypt achieved a limited but real strategic reversal: concentrated artillery and controlled commando attacks forced Israel to revise its defensive line and prevented the complete Egyptian expulsion from the canal front during 1968. Egypt paid heavily in equipment expenditure and troop losses for that result. Israel could not convert air and armored superiority into the destruction of the Egyptian army, and neither side achieved a decisive victory. The wider War of Attrition did not end in 1968. Sporadic artillery fire and limited offensives continued until the final ceasefire took effect on August 7, 1970. The account of the 1968 phase, however, ends with the ceasefire of August 9 and the new forward deployments that followed it.
